segments.title: December
segments.text: Hello Kemps Corner! December is the Party Season Survival Guide. Office parties, family dinners, and a January that is coming whether we like it or not. This month we help members get through the season, and set up the new year before it starts.

segments.title: ₹35L
segments.text: So, the number. Our December target for Kemps Corner is 35 lakh rupees. That's 30 per cent more than last December. Ambitious, yes. Unreasonable, no.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 19.2 lakh rupees. That's 6 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 8.4 lakh, comebacks 4.2 lakh, and everything else 3.15 lakh. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 75 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 547 leads, 279 trials, and 75 buyers, with about 27 per cent of trials converting. Every five trials should become about one member. Make those first classes unforgettable.
Here's where the offers come in. Five offers carry 26 lakh rupees, which is 74 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Boxing Day (Gloves Optional)
segments.text: First up, Boxing Day. Gloves optional. Two days only, twelve-class packs at twenty per cent off. That's 36 buyers, for 5.67 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Everyone: pack buyers, members topping up, newcomers.

segments.title: Resolution Insurance (Claim Approved)
segments.text: Next, for newcomers, Resolution Insurance. Claim approved. Buy your first month now, start any day from the first to the tenth of January, and January's late-cancel fees are on us, plus a freeze for when life happens. That's 13 buyers, for 2.24 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: First-time clients (phone verified); members buying for a January start.

segments.title: The Gift They Won’t Regift
segments.text: Then, the Gift They Won't Regift. A boxed gift: two classes, grip socks, and a thousand rupees off a first membership. That's 29 buyers, for 72,500 rupees.
segments.notes: Members and non-members buying for someone new; offices.

segments.title: The Ex-Files: Season Finale
segments.text: Also this month, for lapsed members, The Ex-Files: Season Finale. Ten per cent off to come back, fifteen on three months, and a plus-one to the NYE Countdown Class. That's 14 buyers, for 2.55 lakh rupees.

segments.title: The Advent-ure Calendar (Opens in January)
segments.text: And finally, the Advent-ure Calendar, which opens in January. Renew in December and take home twelve doors of perks, one a week from the third of January: guest passes, a private, smoothies and a golden door. That's 27 buyers, for 14.8 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, Advent-ure Calendars and gift boxes go on sale. Week two, every December renewal hears the calendar pitch, and offices get their gift boxes. Week three, Ugly Sweater Barre, and Resolution Insurance for the I'll start in January crowd. Week four, Boxing Day packs, and the NYE Countdown Class for our comeback members.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's December at Kemps Corner. 35 lakh rupees, five offers, and 75 buyers to welcome. That's a wrap on 2027. See you on the mat in January.
